turnaround_reason: Highly levered specialty-chemicals cyclical (acetyls + engineered materials) that cut its dividend ~95% to delever through a demand trough driven by weak China/Europe. Bull case is a cyclical demand recovery plus deleveraging driving an outsized equity re-rate.
bullish_points: Deep operating leverage to a chemicals recovery; ~$950M FCF
Dividend cut ~95% + cost/inventory actions freeing cash for debt paydown
Deleveraging models point to 21-23% IRR by 2028 on margin recovery
Revenue growing +8.7% ttm as volumes stabilize
bearish_points: Massive leverage: $12.4B debt, d/e ~270 — equity is a levered call on recovery
Weak demand and overcapacity in acetyls/EM persist (China, Europe)
Already up ~36% YTD — a lot of cyclical optimism priced in
Net margin -12% ttm; margin recovery still 'getting worse before better'
catalyst: Chemical demand inflection + concrete debt-reduction milestones
catalyst_timing: 2026-2027; watch quarterly EM/acetyls volume and leverage ratio
suggested_trade: Spot as part of a cyclical basket; add on pullbacks after the YTD run
key_risk: Demand recovery stalls while leverage stays high, forcing further balance-sheet actions
would_skip_if: Skip if leverage ratio fails to improve or EM/acetyls volumes deteriorate further
